intro.fr: Totally Accurate Battle Simulator se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Totally Accurate Battle Simulator can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Landfall Games sort Totally Accurate Battle Simulator en 2021.
text.en: Landfall Games releases Totally Accurate Battle Simulator in 2021.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub duckboycool/TABS-Archipelago, qui héberge l'APWorld de Totally Accurate Battle Simulator.
text.en: The GitHub repository duckboycool/TABS-Archipelago, home of the Totally Accurate Battle Simulator APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la version v0.1.0 (préversion), seule version parue au 21 octobre 2026.
text.en: Version v0.1.0 (pre-release) is released, the only one as of October 21, 2026.

text.fr: Comme beaucoup de jeux, Totally Accurate Battle Simulator rejoint Archipelago par un APWorld non officiel : un fichier .apworld distribué à part, que chaque joueur ajoute lui-même à son installation pour l'intégrer à un multiworld.
text.en: Like many games, Totally Accurate Battle Simulator joins Archipelago through an unofficial APWorld: a .apworld file distributed separately, which each player adds to their own install to bring it into a multiworld.
